readPolicy.stale: feasibilityStale required boolean on scheduleVersion; stale data remains a 200 projection
readPolicy.progress: progress required and nullable; null means no progress row

versionPolicy.immutable: existing version identity/content and child items/legs are never edited; only atomic draft-to-active and prior active-to-superseded status transitions are allowed
versionPolicy.activation: copy active, apply edit, validate, seal new user_edit version, supersede previous active and switch pointer atomically
versionPolicy.legCompleteness: exactly one adjacent leg for every consecutive item pair; zero for fewer than two

itemPolicy.timezone: RFC 3339 +09:00; start and computed end must remain on target Asia/Seoul trip day
itemPolicy.completedItem: reject-422; completed item cannot be patched, deleted, reordered or moved

idempotency.scope: canonical sub + method + normalized path + Idempotency-Key
idempotency.completedSameHash: COMPLETED same hash replays stored status, ordered headers and body without executing the operation
idempotency.differentHash: different hash returns immediate 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED without Retry-After
idempotency.leaseActiveSameHash: PROCESSING lease-active same hash returns immediate 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED with Retry-After: 1; never waits or replays

retryAfter.appliesTo: PROCESSING lease-active same-hash concurrent loser only

mutationPolicy.concurrency: strong trip aggregate ETag plus expected active schedule version
mutationPolicy.validator: DB constraints and synchronous deterministic validator only
mutationPolicy.aiCorrection: never call MCP/AI; correction requires separate schedule revision run owned by #89

orderPolicy.permutation: each active item ID exactly once across all submitted days; no missing, duplicate, foreign or extra ID
orderPolicy.result: renumber each affected day contiguously from 1 and rebuild every adjacent leg

movePolicy.dayBoundary: target day belongs to trip; local date of plannedStartAt equals target day date
movePolicy.result: remove from source, insert at targetSequenceNo, compact both days, rebuild affected legs

itemIdentityMapping.newIdentity: new UUID for every copied item in the new schedule version
itemIdentityMapping.scope: created before leg derivation and discarded after the transaction; never persisted as cross-version FK

legDerivationPolicy.reuse: map the old ordered adjacent pair through oldItemIdToNewItemId, write fromItemId/toItemId with new item IDs, and reuse only route attributes/components when mapped adjacency and all semanticEquality fields are unchanged; never reuse old leg or old trip_items IDs

storedSnapshot.eligibility: same normalized origin/destination and transport mode, captured before mutation and unexpired at transaction start; route_summary must contain validated walk/wait/ride/transfer components whose sum equals duration_minutes
storedSnapshot.tieBreaker: expiresAt DESC, observedAt DESC, snapshotId ASC
storedSnapshot.components: copy validated route_summary components, distance and fare; risk defaults null when absent; a snapshot without complete components is ineligible

conservativeFallback.eligibility: both adjacent items have normalized coordinates and the computed arrival does not exceed the next plannedStartAt

legDerivationPolicy.timestamps: plannedDepartureAt equals from.plannedEndAt; plannedArrivalAt equals departure plus durationMinutes; both remain on the trip day and arrival is not after to.plannedStartAt
legDerivationPolicy.stableFailure: 422 SCHEDULE_LEG_INCOMPLETE; rollback draft, prior active pointer unchanged
legDerivationPolicy.sealing: derive every affected pair, copy every reusable unaffected pair, require exactly n-1 contiguous legs per day, run DB sealing validator, then seal and CAS-activate in the same transaction
legDerivationPolicy.ownership: Spring implementation #50/#51 owns local derivation and atomic activation; #90 may refresh stored snapshots asynchronously but is never called by these requests

add.affectedPairs: replace predecessor→successor with predecessor→new and new→successor; day edges derive only the existing side
add.identityMapping: oldItemIdToNewItemId maps every copied survivor; added item has only a new ID

delete.affectedPairs: remove legs touching deleted item and derive predecessor→successor when both exist
delete.identityMapping: oldItemIdToNewItemId excludes the deleted item and maps every survivor

reorder.affectedPairs: derive every adjacent pair whose ordered endpoints changed; reuse only unchanged pairs
reorder.identityMapping: oldItemIdToNewItemId maps every item; adjacency comparison uses old pair mapped to new IDs

move.affectedPairs: apply delete rule to source day and add rule to target day, then validate both days
move.identityMapping: oldItemIdToNewItemId maps moved and surviving items; source/target adjacency uses new IDs

figma.reason: 일정 화면과 6개 API의 node/action/response 연결을 직접 관찰하지 못해 not-linked로 유지한다

schemaGap: 문서 작업은 schema를 변경하지 않으며 public schema 단일 기준은 supabase/migrations이다
trip_items에는 accommodation/transport-event 전용 FK가 없고 stay_minutes는 null/0 및 상한 없음이어서 #50에서 migration과 application validator 책임을 명시적으로 결정한다
trip_legs에는 derivation source/algorithm version/snapshot ID 전용 column이 없으므로 #50/#51에서 facts 저장 규약 또는 migration을 결정한다
Spring/FastAPI 운영 코드와 Flyway는 이 Issue 범위가 아니다
